description: Vanilla JavaScript and CSS alerts, confirms, prompts, and toasts with a glassmorphism UI and zero runtime dependencies.

features.name: safe_text_rendering
features.title: Escape user text to prevent XSS
features.description: Render title and text values as text while keeping html and iconHtml as explicit markup opt-ins.
acceptance: title and text are rendered with textContent.
html and iconHtml continue to support explicit markup.
HTML supplied through text is displayed literally and never executed.
Regression tests cover an XSS payload.

features.name: small_bug_fixes
features.title: Fix small modal, toast, theme, and DOM bugs
features.description: Resolve the identified timing, CSS variable, toast positioning, theme stylesheet, and import-time DOM issues.
acceptance: Modal close timing matches the CSS transition.
The backdrop blur CSS variable is applied.
Visible toasts keep their own position when another toast is created.
Theme stylesheet replacement does not create duplicate IDs.
Importing before document.body exists does not throw.
Regression tests cover the corrected behaviors.

features.name: input_prompt_api
features.title: Add input support and Crystal.prompt()
features.description: Provide configurable text, numeric, textarea, select, checkbox, and password inputs in modal dialogs.
acceptance: fire supports text, email, password, number, textarea, select, and checkbox inputs.
Placeholder, initial value, and select options are configurable.
Async inputValidator can return an inline validation message.
The submitted input value is available to then and preConfirm.
Crystal.prompt(title, options) is a convenience API.
The demo and README document the feature.

features.name: modal_timer
features.title: Add modal timers and timer progress bars
features.description: Automatically close modal dialogs after a configured duration and optionally show progress.
acceptance: timer closes the modal after the configured duration.
timerProgressBar renders remaining time without affecting modal content.
Manual confirmation or dismissal cancels the timer safely.
The resolved result identifies timer dismissal.

features.name: modal_queue
features.title: Queue concurrent modal dialogs
features.description: Prevent concurrent fire calls from orphaning the promise belonging to an earlier modal.
acceptance: Multiple fire calls are handled in FIFO order.
Every fire promise resolves exactly once.
The active modal is not overwritten by a later call.
Queue behavior is covered by tests.

features.name: toast_handle
features.title: Return a real toast handle
features.description: Expose stable toast lifecycle controls for closing and updating an existing toast.
acceptance: toast returns an object containing id, close, and update.
close removes only the referenced toast.
update changes content and supported options in place.
closeToast and closeAllToasts are available on Crystal.
Handle behavior is covered by tests.

features.name: toast_lifecycle
features.title: Add toast lifecycle controls
features.description: Support hover pausing, optional close buttons, and close callbacks or promise resolution.
acceptance: pauseOnHover pauses and resumes the dismissal timer.
showCloseButton renders a usable close control.
onClose runs once for every dismissal path.
Lifecycle callbacks do not fire after a toast has already closed.

features.name: focus_trap
features.title: Trap focus inside modal dialogs
features.description: Keep keyboard focus within the active modal and restore it to the previously focused element.
acceptance: Tab cycles through focusable modal controls.
Shift+Tab cycles in reverse.
Focus cannot escape to the page behind the modal.
Focus is restored after dismissal.

features.name: modal_aria_labels
features.title: Add modal ARIA relationships
features.description: Connect modal labels and descriptions using generated IDs and ARIA attributes.
acceptance: The modal has aria-labelledby when a title is present.
The modal has aria-describedby when descriptive text is present.
Generated IDs are unique for simultaneous DOM elements.
Tests verify the resulting relationships.

features.name: announced_toasts
features.title: Make toasts accessible to screen readers
features.description: Expose toast notifications through appropriate live-region semantics.
acceptance: Toast containers use status and polite live-region semantics by default.
Error notifications can use assertive announcements.
ARIA attributes do not change visual behavior.

features.name: reduced_motion
features.title: Respect prefers-reduced-motion
features.description: Disable or reduce modal and toast animations for users who request reduced motion.
acceptance: The library defines a prefers-reduced-motion media query.
Modal and toast transitions are reduced or disabled under that preference.
Normal motion remains unchanged.

features.name: dismissal_controls
features.title: Configure Escape and outside-click dismissal
features.description: Allow callers to disable dismissal through Escape or backdrop clicks.
acceptance: allowEscapeKey controls Escape dismissal.
allowOutsideClick controls backdrop dismissal.
Both options default to the current dismissible behavior.
Disabled dismissal does not resolve the modal prematurely.

features.name: esm_distribution
features.title: Add modern ESM and global distribution
features.description: Provide ESM exports, an explicit browser global, and package export metadata.
acceptance: The package exposes CrystalAlert and Crystal through ESM.
Script usage exposes window.Crystal without breaking existing usage.
package.json declares exports and module entry points.
The generated distribution remains dependency-free.

features.name: typescript_types
features.title: Publish TypeScript declarations
features.description: Describe the public API and option objects with a crystal-alert.d.ts declaration file.
acceptance: The declaration file covers CrystalAlert and the Crystal singleton.
Alert, confirm, prompt, and toast options are typed.
Promise result types distinguish confirmation and dismissal.
package.json points to the declaration file.

features.name: defaults_and_i18n
features.title: Add global defaults and localization
features.description: Allow applications to configure default options and localized built-in labels.
acceptance: Crystal.setDefaults updates defaults for future dialogs and toasts.
A locale object configures built-in labels such as OK, Cancel, Close, and Alert.
Per-call options override global defaults.
Existing defaults remain backward compatible.

features.name: responsive_layout
features.title: Improve responsive layouts
features.description: Keep modals and toasts usable on narrow screens without overflow.
acceptance: Toasts fit within small viewport widths.
Modal content remains usable on mobile screens.
Existing desktop layout and theme variables remain compatible.

features.name: extended_css_variables
features.title: Expand theme CSS variables
features.description: Expose additional visual controls for toast sizing, colors, animation, icons, and progress bars.
acceptance: Documented variables control the relevant visual properties.
The declared font-family variable is applied.
Base and bundled themes provide sensible values.
Existing custom themes continue to work.

features.name: automatic_dark_mode
features.title: Support prefers-color-scheme dark mode
features.description: Offer an opt-in automatic dark theme based on the operating system preference.
acceptance: Applications can enable automatic dark mode.
The system preference selects the appropriate theme.
Explicit setTheme calls take precedence when configured.
The behavior works without runtime dependencies.

features.name: custom_icons
features.title: Add question and danger icons with global customization
features.description: Complete the built-in icon set and allow applications to override icons globally.
acceptance: question and danger icons are available by name.
Crystal.setIcons accepts overrides for built-in icons.
Per-call iconHtml remains supported as an explicit markup escape hatch.
Default icons remain backward compatible.
